items.title: ECZ Past Paper Questions & Marking Key — Principles of Accounts Paper 1 (2016–2019, 2021)
items._source: Real Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) O-Level Principles of Accounts Paper 1 (7110/1) past-paper questions, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2021 (2020's question paper was not available from the source used — only that year's answer key, which is not included here since it has no matching real questions to pair with). Extracted from a privately-compiled Zambian revision booklet shared with this project — the booklet's own compiler name, contact details, and 'buy from me'/anti-sharing text have been stripped entirely and are not reproduced anywhere in this file or credited in any way; only the real ECZ exam questions and each one's correct answer (cross-referenced from the same booklet's own separately-printed answer key, letter verified against standard accounting principles) are kept, attributed only to ECZ. 40 questions per year, one paragraph per question (question stem + all four options + the correct one), formatted for this app's offline keyword search.

items.title: ECZ Past Paper Questions & Marking Key — Grade 10 Science, Chemistry Section, Paper 1 (2009–2019)
items._source: Real Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) Grade 10 Science (Chemistry section) Paper 1 multiple-choice past-paper questions, spanning 2009–2017 plus the 2017 and 2019 General Certificate of Education (G.C.E.) sittings (58 real ECZ questions found in the source; 6 were excluded here because they depend on a diagram, apparatus photo, or data table that this text-only extraction could not capture and would be meaningless or misleading without it — 52 fully self-contained questions were kept). Extracted from a privately-compiled Zambian revision booklet shared with this project — the booklet's own compiler name and price notice (confined to its title page, outside the extracted question/answer content) have been stripped entirely and are not reproduced anywhere in this file or credited in any way; only the real ECZ exam questions and each one's correct answer (cross-referenced from the same booklet's own separately-printed answer key) are kept, attributed only to ECZ. One paragraph per question (question stem + all four options + the correct one), formatted for this app's offline keyword search.

items.title: ECZ Past Paper Questions & Model Answers — Civic Education Paper 2, Section A (2017–2020)
items._source: Real Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) Civic Education 2030/2 Paper 2, Section A (short-answer) past-paper questions from five sittings: July 2017, November 2017, July 2018, November 2018, and 2020 (70 of the 71 real questions found in the source; 1 was excluded because the intended answer could not be confidently identified). Unlike the app's MCQ-format bundled content, this subject's real answer is a short written response rather than a lettered option, so per this project's sourcing rule each answer here was independently composed in this app's own words rather than copied from the privately-compiled revision booklet this was sourced from -- the booklet's own written answers (where it gave any) were used only as a cross-check, and are not reproduced; one answer (the 1991 Mvunga Constitutional Review Commission's real recommendations) was corrected against an independent source after the booklet's own stated answer could not be verified. The booklet's compiler name, price, and contact details (confined to its title page) are not reproduced anywhere. Section B (comprehension/table-based) and Section C (long-form essay) questions from the same papers were left out of this pass. One paragraph per question (real ECZ question + a fresh model answer), formatted for this app's offline keyword search.

items.title: ECZ Past Paper Questions & Marking Key — Pure Chemistry Paper 1 (5070/1), 2015–2021
items._source: Real Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) O-Level Pure Chemistry Paper 1 (5070/1) multiple-choice past-paper questions, 2015 through 2021 (all 7 sittings, each with the paper's real official ECZ header confirming the sitting date). 223 of the 280 real questions in the source were kept; 57 were excluded because they depend on a diagram, graph, or structural-formula image this text-only extraction could not capture (including a handful where the OCR text visibly corrupted into unreadable placeholder characters, or where two adjacent real questions' text ran together and could not be reliably separated) -- bundling those would mean a guessed or meaningless answer, so they were left out rather than faked. A small number of the 2021 sitting's answers were unavailable because the source document's own answer key was itself cut off before reaching them; those questions are included in the source's own text but were left unpaired here. Extracted from a privately-compiled Zambian revision booklet shared with this project -- the booklet's own compiler name, contact details, and 'buy from me'/anti-sharing text have been stripped entirely and are not reproduced anywhere in this file or credited in any way; only the real ECZ exam questions and each one's correct answer (cross-referenced from the same booklet's own separately-printed answer key) are kept, attributed only to ECZ. One paragraph per question (question stem + all four options + the correct one), formatted for this app's offline keyword search.

items.title: ECZ Past Paper Questions & Model Answers — Geography Paper 2 (2218/2), 2015–2019
items._source: Real Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) Geography 2218/2 Paper 2 (structured/essay) past-paper questions from 5 sittings: 2015 through 2019 (52 consolidated questions -- one paragraph per real numbered exam question, combining all of that question's real lettered/numbered sub-parts). The source booklet claims to cover 2015-2022, but its text extraction degrades into an unrecoverable repeating OCR error partway through the 2019 sitting, so 2020-2022 could not be extracted at all and are not included here; nor could the small number of Question 1 sub-parts that fell before the 2019 sitting's own text began. As with Civic Education, this is a short-answer/essay subject rather than MCQ, so each answer here was independently composed (checked against general geography/economic knowledge and, for several Zambia/Southern Africa-specific facts, verified against independent sources) rather than copied from the privately-compiled revision booklet this was sourced from -- the booklet's own given bullet-point answers were used only as a cross-check, never reproduced verbatim. A small number of sub-parts that require physically drawing or marking a sketch map (unanswerable as text) were left out; where a real question referenced a map/diagram 'insert' but the booklet's own answer named a real, independently-identifiable place or feature, that real information was kept. The booklet's own compiler name, price, and contact details (confined to its title page and recurring page footers) have been stripped entirely and are not reproduced anywhere in this file.

items.title: ECZ Past Paper Questions & Model Answers — Biology Paper 2 Essay Questions, Grades 10-12 (2009–2019)
items._source: Real Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) Biology Paper 2 structured/essay (Section B) past-paper questions, organized by the level they were taught at (Grade 10, 11, and 12) across sittings from 2009 to 2019 (65 consolidated questions total -- one paragraph per real numbered exam question, combining its real lettered sub-parts). This source booklet's Section A (short-answer) content is almost entirely built around labelled diagrams (cell structures, dissections, graphs, genetic crosses) that this text-only extraction cannot see, so Section A was left out entirely as unusable rather than guessed at; Section B's essay questions, by contrast, are mostly self-contained conceptual questions (e.g. 'explain how leaves are adapted for photosynthesis', 'describe the nitrogen cycle') answerable without seeing any figure, and were kept. As with Civic Education and Geography, each answer here was independently composed from established biology knowledge rather than copied from the privately-compiled booklet this was sourced from -- the booklet's own given answers (available for Grade 10 and Grade 11) were used only as a cross-check, never reproduced verbatim; the Grade 12 essay section's own answer key was itself cut off by the same source file's text extraction before it began, so those answers were composed from biology knowledge alone, with no compiler reference available to cross-check against (all standard O-level topics: plant/human reproduction, ecology and nutrient cycles, population biology, soil fertility, puberty). The booklet's own compiler name, price, and contact details are stripped entirely and not reproduced anywhere in this file.

items.title: ECZ Past Paper Questions & Model Answers — Biology Paper 2 Essay Questions Vol.2 (2018 G.C.E, 2020-2021)
items._source: Real Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) Biology 5090/2 Paper 2 Section B (essay) past-paper questions from a second compiled source ('Volume Two'), covering sittings not already captured by this app's other Biology bundle: July 2018 (G.C.E.), and both the G.C.E. and regular November sittings of 2020 and 2021 (25 questions total). Most of this second source's sittings duplicate real questions already bundled from the first source and were skipped to avoid redundant content; only these 5 genuinely new sittings were processed. This source's own answer key was itself cut off by its own text extraction before reaching any of these 5 sittings, so every answer here was composed from established biology knowledge alone, with no compiler reference available to check against -- all standard O-level topics (respiration, the heart, reflexes, reproduction, ecology, blood, sensory organs). The source booklet's own compiler name, price and contact details are stripped entirely and not reproduced anywhere in this file.

items.title: ECZ Past Paper Questions & Model Answers — English Language Paper 2, Structure/Grammar (2009–2017)
items._source: Real Examinations Council of Zambia (ECZ) English Language Paper 2 grammar/structure and vocabulary/lexis questions (sentence transformation, preposition/particle choice, synonym selection, homophone and word-choice exercises, cloze word-bank completion) from 9 sittings, 2009 through 2017, drawn from two separate compiled sources sharing the same underlying real exam papers (the second source supplied the one year, 2016, missing from the first). A small number of individual items within a few years were omitted where the source's own text extraction had garbled or scrambled them beyond confident reconstruction -- most notably an entire 2012 cloze passage about disease prevalence in Zambia, whose sentences appeared out of their original order. This subject's Paper 2 also includes Summary and Comprehension questions, but those are answered entirely in reference to a specific full reading passage printed on the exam paper; reproducing those passages here raises a different and more serious copyright question than the short, self-contained grammar items in this file (which are ECZ's own brief test items, not extended narrative prose), so Summary and Comprehension content was deliberately left out of this bundle entirely. Every completion/correction/answer given here was independently composed by this app (standard English grammar and vocabulary, with no single 'right' phrasing in some transformation items, so a reasonable equivalent is given); neither source provided any answer key for this section beyond one worked example per exercise. The booklets' own compiler name, price and contact details are stripped entirely and not reproduced anywhere in this file.
